title: Patient Statements and Collection Referrals — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Credit and collections policy for Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility accounts.**

## Statements

An account whose patient balance is above 0.00 receives a statement every statement cycle of the class (in calendar days), numbered from 1 since the balance last stood at 0.00 or below.

## Referral to collections

An account may be referred to collections only when all of the following hold:

- the count of statements showing an unpaid balance has reached the class's number of statements before collections;
- the balance is at least the class's smallest referable balance; and
- the class permits referral to an outside collection agency.

It is never referred while an arrangement is in good standing: the account's payment-arrangement status is none, defaulted or completed. That status is read from the coverage record before the referral. It is also never referred while a hardship application request on the account is submitted, while any charge in the balance stems from a claim line with a pending appeal request in its equipment category, or while the patient is QMB-protected.

## Counting unpaid statements

The count runs from the most recent posting date on which the account's running patient balance stood at 0.00 or below (or from account opening if it never did) up to the handling date, and it counts the statements on the coverage account whose balance due is greater than 0.00.

## Referral decision table (class figures taken as 3 statements and 50.00)

| Unpaid statements | Balance | Class permits referral | Arrangement status | Other bars present | Referral |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 120.00 | yes | none | none | may be referred |
| 2 | 120.00 | yes | none | none | not referred |
| 3 | 49.99 | yes | none | none | not referred |
| 3 | 120.00 | no | none | none | not referred |
| 3 | 120.00 | yes | active | none | not referred |
| 3 | 120.00 | yes | defaulted | hardship application submitted | not referred |
| 3 | 120.00 | yes | completed | none | may be referred |
